[gold]Dip[/gold] use is not removed on the first play each turn.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-SCIMITAR_REPURPOSE.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Remove all your [gold]Dexterity[/gold]; gain half as much [gold]energy[/gold].
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-SCIMITAR_VITAL_INFECTI:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If this weapon has a [gold]Dip[/gold], apply {Vulnerable:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and {Weak:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-SCIMITAR_LIGHTSPEED.de:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply {Shocked:diff()} [gold]Shocked[/gold]. [gold]Shocked[/gold] is not removed this turn.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-SCIMITAR_REGROUP.title: Scimitar Regroup
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-SCIMITAR_REGROUP.descr: Once per turn, when you gain [gold]Dexterity[/gold], gain {Extra:diff()} extra [gold]Dexterity[/gold] this turn.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-HALBERD_CHARGE.title: Halberd Charge
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-HALBERD_CHARGE.descrip:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Gain {Strength:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-HALBERD_DISARM.title: Halberd Disarm
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-HALBERD_BUTT.title: Halberd Butt
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-HALBERD_BUTT.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
A random 1 cost non-two-handed weapon attack is free to play this turn.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-HALBERD_STANCE.title: Halberd Stance
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-HALBERD_STANCE.descrip: Gain {Dexterity:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold] for every weapon attack played this turn ({Gain}).
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-HALBERD_UNYIELDING.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you lose HP this turn, gain {Vigor:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold] next turn.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-HALBERD_FLAWLESS_STRIK:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] for each two-handed weapon played this turn ({Gain}).
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-HALBERD_HOLY_GUARD.des: Whenever you gain [gold]Strength[/gold], gain twice as much [gold]Block[/gold].
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-MAUL_CONCUSSION.title: Maul Concussion
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-MAUL_CONCUSSION.descri: Your next {Attacks} [gold]Bludgeoning[/gold] attacks apply [gold]Weak[/gold]. On the last, apply {Vulnerable:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-MAUL_STOMACH_BURST.des: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Gain {Extra:diff()} more for each weapon in your hand with a [gold]Dip[/gold].
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-MAUL_FULL_FORCE.title: Maul Full Force
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-MAUL_ICEBREAKER.title: Maul Icebreaker
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-MAUL_ICEBREAKER.descri:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Remove all [gold]Frostbite[/gold] from the target, ALL enemies lose HP equal to the [gold]Frostbite[/gold] removed.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-MAUL_BACKBREAKER.title: Maul Backbreaker
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-MAUL_BACKBREAKER.descr:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Remove this weapon's [gold]Dip[/gold] and apply its effects now.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-MAUL_EARTHSHAKER.title: Maul Earthshaker
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-MAUL_EARTHSHAKER.descr: Whenever you gain a power, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-MAUL_THUNDER_BLAST.des:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. Weapon attacks drawn gain a {DipUses} [gold]Use[/gold], {DipStrength} strength [gold]Thunder[/gold] [gold]Dip[/gold].
ALL enemies gain [gold]Reverberation[/gold].
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-BAIT_AND_SWITCH.title: Bait and Switch
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-QUICK_TOSS.title: Quick Toss
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-MENACING_ATTACK.title: Menacing Attack
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-ACTION_SURGE.title: Action Surge
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-ACTION_SURGE.descripti:
Select {Cards:diff()} cards.
They cost 0 this turn.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-ACTION_SURGE.selection: Choose cards to make free this turn.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-SPEAR_ADVANTAGE_STRIKE:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the target is [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], add a 0 cost copy on top of your draw pile.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-SPEAR_FRONTLINE.title: Spear Frontline
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-SPEAR_STANDBY.title: Spear Standby
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-SPEAR_SPARE_TIME.title: Spear Spare Time
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-SPEAR_SPARE_TIME.descr: Select up to 2 weapon attacks in your draw pile, give them a random [gold]Dip[/gold] with [gold]Use[/gold] {DipUses} and strength {DipStrength:diff()}.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-SPEAR_OFFLOAD.title: Spear Offload
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-SPEAR_OFFLOAD.descript: Whenever an Attack card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold], gain 1 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-SPEAR_PHALANX.title: Spear Phalanx
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-SPEAR_PHALANX.descript: Gain [gold]Block[/gold] and [gold]Vigor[/gold] equal to twice your two-handed cards in hand.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-SPEAR_LAST_LINE.title: Spear Last Line
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-SPEAR_LAST_LINE.descri: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If this is the last card in your hand, draw 2 and gain 2 energy.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-CROSSBOW_ARCANE_SYNC.d: Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. If one is a [gold]Cantrip[/gold], gain 1 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-CROSSBOW_LOADED_BOLT.d: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If this card has a [gold]Dip[/gold], apply its effect too.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-CROSSBOW_REPEATER.desc: [gold]Piercing[/gold] cards and [gold]Bow[/gold] or [gold]Cantrip[/gold] attacks cost 1 less this turn.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-CROSSBOW_VOLLEY.title: Crossbow Volley
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-CROSSBOW_VOLLEY.descri: Play all Attacks in your hand, then [gold]Exhaust[/gold] the rest.
At the start of your turn, add a random [gold]Piercing[/gold] weapon attack from your draw pile to your hand.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-CROSSBOW_LEGENDARY.des: The third Attack you play each turn is played an extra time.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-CROSSBOW_BALLISTA.desc: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, increased by 4 for each energy spent this turn.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-GREATSWORD_MOMENTUM_SW:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Hits:diff()} times.
Your two-handed bonus carries onto the next weapon you switch to.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-GREATSWORD_COOL_OFF.de: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Costs 1 less for each weapon attack played this turn.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-GREATSWORD_DIPPED_GUAR: Whenever you play a card with a [gold]Dip[/gold], gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-GREATSWORD_FOLLOW_THRO:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If your previous card was a two-handed attack, this hits twice.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-GREATSWORD_POISE.title: Greatsword Poise
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-GREATSWORD_POISE.descr:
Gain {Strength:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
Your next Attack is free to play.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-GREATSWORD_MASSACRE.de: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage X times. Gain X*2 [gold]Vigor[/gold].
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-GREATSWORD_EXECUTE.des: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Kill the target if it is below {Percent:diff()}% of its max HP.
Consecutive two-handed weapon attacks give 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
